name: Audio Formant Analysis
description: Analyzes speech formant frequencies (F1-F4) — voice synthesis often produces unnatural formant transitions.
algorithm: Audio Formant Analysis分析アルゴリズム
mechanism:
This method analyzes speech formant structure for audio deepfake detection following Chetty & Wagner (2006):

1. **フォルマント抽出**: Speech segments are analyzed using Linear Predictive Coding (LPC) to extract formant frequencies F1-F4 and their bandwidths. Formants are the resonant frequencies of the vocal tract, determined by physical anatomy — tongue position, jaw opening, and vocal tract length.

2. **フォルマントTrajectory分析**: Temporal trajectories of formant frequencies are tracked across phoneme transitions. Natural speech shows smooth, physiologically constrained formant transitions governed by articulatory dynamics. AI-generated speech may exhibit unnaturally abrupt formant shifts or overly smooth trajectories lacking natural micro-variations.

3. **Speaker-Specificフォルマントモデリング**: Each speaker has characteristic formant ranges determined by vocal tract geometry. The method builds a speaker-specific formant model and checks consistency — deepfake audio may inadvertently blend formant characteristics from source and target speakers, creating acoustically impossible vocal tract configurations.

4. **フォルマントBandwidth分析**: Natural formant bandwidths reflect the damping properties of the vocal tract. AI synthesis often produces formants with unnatural bandwidth patterns — either too narrow (over-resonant) or too uniform across frequency bands, lacking the frequency-dependent damping of real vocal tracts.

5. **Harmonic-to-フォルマントRatio**: The relationship between harmonic series and formant peaks is analyzed. In natural speech, harmonics interact with formant resonances in predictable ways governed by source-filter theory. Synthetic speech may show anomalous harmonic-formant relationships indicating generated rather than physical sound production.

strengths: • 研究に裏付けられた方法論\n• 高速な計算時間\n• 他の検出方法と相補的
limitations: • 精度は入力品質により変動\n• 他の方法と組み合わせて使用するのが最適
